lyrics:
The love of Christ has gathered us together,
Rejoice in Him and be glad.

1. My soul longs for the Lord,
Rise, 0 Lord, to our need.
Make your power known.

2. With the Lord is mercy
And fullness of redemption:
Praised be his name.

3. Show, 0 Lord, your way;
Lead us to our home;
Light the way for us.

4. Sing praise to the Lord;
Proclaim his glorious name;
Open your hearts to Him.

5. To the Father, praise;
Praise him through the Son,
By his Spirit's love.
